text:
GENERATE BURST DM-2-south — Run C-9, a horned, fanged, scaly demon as a SOUTH-FACING STILL for the game scene (Matt R-C9-31). task_id "DM-2-south".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (a horned, fanged, scaly demon, copied from a 15th/16th-century painting, background flat green). KEEP THE ORIGINAL PAINTER'S HAND exactly: the same line, brushwork, gold, worn pigment and imperfections. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 1: do not re-render, smooth, sharpen or restyle.

Change ONLY the view: he faces STRAIGHT TOWARD THE VIEWER (south), standing, and is seen from a game camera looking DOWN on him from about 50 degrees above the ground — the top of the head and the tops of the shoulders visible, the body slightly foreshortened, the feet seen from above; no perspective distortion. Keep his curling horns, fanged open jaws, red eyes, scaly dark hide with red and gold highlights, clawed hands (raised, menacing), clawed legs and long tail (curling to one side) exactly. Full figure, feet at the bottom centre, filling about 75 % of the frame height; flat uniform pure #00ff00 background; no ground, no shadow, no text.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if he does not face the viewer, the view is not from above, the figure was restyled, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/DM-2-south_a.png and out/DM-2-south_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "DM-2-south"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (preserve the painter's hand; change only the view)
